note: Blanco County does not appear to publish county zoning districts. The city of Blanco publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (2021 Zoning Map, DocumentCenter/View/558) with no GIS service. The city of Johnson City, TX publishes its zoning map only as PDF (22-0104 approved zoning map, city base map). The Datahub 'Zoning Districts' layer (jctngis) is Johnson City, Tennessee, not Texas. No queryable ArcGIS zoning polygon layer was found for Blanco County or its cities.
